title: Normalized singleton comparison equals the evaluation mate
statement: For arbitrary compatible exact geometric inverse images of strict systems [lem-pur-system-singleton-geometric-pullback], and any supplied ordinary geometric adjunctions, the conjugate of the specified normalized derived singleton comparison under the composite adjunctions equals the derived right mate of the exact evaluation square.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03DA, 07A6 and 0D6E; normalized adjunction and coefficient comparison argument.

proof.text:
Take the right mate of the inverse-image/evaluation square under the normalized
singleton adjunctions. On a flat-term K-flat representative its inverse is the ordinary
singleton geometric comparison: transpose its ordinary multiplication identity using the
singleton unit, and then use the representative formula for the normalized derived
adjunction. The representative clause in SystemSingletonGeometricComparisons identifies
this with the specified comparison on every resolving complex. Every derived object is
isomorphic to such a representative, so naturality identifies the two singleton maps
on every object. Taking their conjugates under the two composite geometric/singleton
adjunctions gives the claimed equality of right mates, by horizontal mate pasting.

proof_origin.place: Adjunction transposition and derived composition; explicit argument in Lean docstring.
